title: Table 2.4 Recommended community consultation parameters

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 1 - Operation of the Code.pdf

notes: Recommended, not mandatory; clause 64 of Schedule 2 of the LPS Regulations governs. Consultation is recommended only for elements assessed on merit that may affect the amenity of adjoining properties or the street. Elements not listed (private open space, trees and landscaping, retaining existing dwellings, access) have no recommended parameter.
